mail.subject: How to write your letter of adhesion to the Pact
mail.intro: We received {organization}'s interest in joining the Pact for the Development of the Aerospace Sector in the State of Puebla.
mail.deadline: To be included in the signing on November 30, 2026, the signed letter must arrive as a PDF by November 13, 2026, at secretariado@clusterdestartups.org.
mail.addressee:
Rodrigo Yamil Álvarez Moisés
Presidente
Clúster de Startups e Innovación, A.C.
Presente
mail.format:
1. Place and date. For example: Heroica Puebla de Zaragoza, [day] of [month], 2026.
2. The addressee, as written above.
3. Subject: Adhesión al Pacto por el Desarrollo del Sector Aeroespacial en el Estado de Puebla.
4. Who is writing and which organization they represent, with legal authority.
5. Why they want to join.
6. What they bring to the aerospace ecosystem.
7. What commitments they intend to take on.
8. Close with «Atentamente», the name, the role, and the signature.
mail.draftTitle: This is what you wrote. You can use it as the basis of the letter:
mail.signoff: The letter is signed by the person who can represent the organization.
